name: forever-twins-harness
description: Forever Twins simnet evidence, v2 acceptance tests, source screener and read-only live checks. No keys, no broadcasts.

scripts.test: npm run render && npm run test:existing && npm run test:v2 && npm run test:families && npm run test:v3 && npm run test:prebind && npm run test:manifest && npm run test:registry && npm run test:shared-probe && npm run test:live-check
scripts.screen: python3 screener/screen_sources.py screener/sources > results/screen.json && python3 screener/summarise.py results/screen.json
